$what: connection:snap-fit-ankle-blocks — the two ankle blocks in the two foot through-pockets, plus the cylindrical cradle they seat on. Measured with cecad.meshfeatures.intervals ray-cast calipers and cecad.meshslice circle fits on Pollen's ankle_left.stl and foot_left.stl (metres, scale 1000), 2026-09-02, ce-designs/microduck lane T

blocks.note: the ankle declares NO interface for these blocks today; the foot's `ankle_cradle` row names them from the ankle's part.py BLOCK_X. Lane T measured them directly off the mesh and added the `foot_blocks` row to the ankle folder.

sides.mirror: the right side is the same joint on part:microduck-ankle-right / part:microduck-foot-right

frame: Pollen's shared mesh frame for the left ankle group: x heel 30 .. toe 70, y -12 .. 42, z up; the ankle axis is the x-line through (y 22.0000, z -6.2230).

pockets.through_in_z_how: cecad.meshfeatures.intervals along z at (x 36.5, y 32.4), (36.5, 34.9), (63.5, 32.4), (34.2, 32.4) and (39.0, 32.4) all return NO material at all — the pocket is open top to bottom.

clearance_mm.how: pocket 5.2000 - block 5.0000 in x; pocket 4.2000 - block 4.0000 in y. Both read off the two meshes on the same lines with the same instrument.
clearance_mm.reading: a 0.1000 mm slip fit per side: a LOCATING pair, not an interference and not a snap.

ankle_under_hull.nominal: R16.3 about (y 22.0000, z -6.2230), 107.7 deg of arc, 34.0000 mm long in x (cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders partial-arc fit Ø32.6000 at centre (50, 22, -6.223))
ankle_under_hull.reading: R16.3018-16.3058 about a centre 0.007-0.011 mm from the declared ankle axis — the hull IS R16.3000 on the ankle axis.

foot_seat.cited_not_re_measured: R16.3 cylindrical seat on the x 32.9000..34.1500 / 65.8500..67.1000 ledges, and an R16.5 relief band across the rib tops at y 12.9000..31.1000 — MEASURED in part:microduck-foot-left's own cad/interfaces.json ('ankle_cradle' and 'roller_slot' rows, seat probes X/D at y 10/16/22/28/34).
foot_seat.why_not_re_measured: lane T's own circle fits at x 33.5 and 66.5 came back r 16.556-16.646 with residual mean 0.031-0.044 mm: the annulus window catches the R16.5 relief band and the ledge together. That is a worse instrument than the one the foot folder already used, and a worse measurement does not replace a better one.
foot_seat.derived_radial_clearance_how: R16.5 relief band minus R16.3 ledge, both from the foot folder: the ribs stand 0.2000 mm clear of the ankle hull so the load lands on the two end ledges, not on the ribs.

no_snap_was_found.claim_tested: the slug is `snap-fit-ankle-blocks` and the foot's `ankle_cradle` row accepts it
no_snap_was_found.searched_for: an undercut, barb, lip or lead-in on either the blocks or the pockets
no_snap_was_found.measurement: the pockets are OPEN top to bottom in z at every station probed, so there is no lip for a barb to pass; the blocks are prismatic over their whole measured height (x span constant 34.1000..39.1000 for y 31.8..35.5 at z -20, and the z intervals at (36.5, 32.4) and (36.5, 34.9) are single unbroken spans with no step); and the fit is a 0.1000 mm per-side CLEARANCE, which nothing can snap into.
no_snap_was_found.what_actually_retains_the_foot: the single M2 at (x 50.0000, y 4.5020): part:microduck-ankle-left `foot_screw` (Ø2.2 through a 2.5 mm plate with a Ø4.4 x 1.0 counterbore) into part:microduck-foot-left `ankle_screw` (Ø1.6 x 5.5 thread-forming pilot with a Ø3.0 x 0.5 relief on a Ø5 boss) — connection:threaded-m2.
no_snap_was_found.verdict: the joint is a two-spigot LOCATION and anti-rotation pair on a cylindrical cradle, screw-retained. `snap-fit` is a name, not a measurement, and compat.py carries `claims_a_snap` as the guard.
